{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Database.Mongo.QueryBuilder where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), object, (.=), encode)
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Aeson.Key as Key
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- | Role hierarchy for RBAC
data Role = Guest | User | Moderator | Admin
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Read)

-- | Session context
data SessionCtx = SessionCtx
  { sessionUser :: Text
  , sessionRole :: Role
  , sessionTenant :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Query filter representation
data QueryFilter
  = FieldEq Text Value
  | FieldIn Text [Value]
  | FieldRegex Text Text
  | AndFilter [QueryFilter]
  | OrFilter [QueryFilter]
  deriving (Show)

-- | Compile a QueryFilter to a BSON-like JSON document
compileFilter :: QueryFilter -> Value
compileFilter (FieldEq field val) =
  object [Key.fromText field .= val]
compileFilter (FieldIn field vals) =
  object [Key.fromText field .= object ["$in" .= vals]]
compileFilter (FieldRegex field pattern) =
  object [Key.fromText field .= object ["$regex" .= pattern]]
compileFilter (AndFilter filters) =
  object ["$and" .= map compileFilter filters]
compileFilter (OrFilter filters) =
  object ["$or" .= map compileFilter filters]

-- | Tenant isolation filter - ensures queries are scoped
tenantFilter :: SessionCtx -> QueryFilter
tenantFilter ctx = FieldEq "tenant_id" (String (sessionTenant ctx))

-- | Role-based field projection
allowedFields :: Role -> [Text]
allowedFields Guest     = ["name", "public_info"]
allowedFields User      = ["name", "email", "public_info", "created_at"]
allowedFields Moderator = ["name", "email", "public_info", "created_at", "flags"]
allowedFields Admin     = []  -- empty means all fields

-- | Sanitize a text value to prevent operator injection
-- Removes MongoDB operator prefixes from string values
sanitizeValue :: Value -> Value
sanitizeValue (String t)
  | "$" `T.isPrefixOf` t = String (T.drop 1 t)
  | otherwise = String t
sanitizeValue (Object obj) = Object (fmap sanitizeValue obj)
sanitizeValue (Array arr) = Array (fmap sanitizeValue arr)
sanitizeValue other = other

-- | Build a secure query with RBAC enforcement
-- This applies tenant isolation and role-based restrictions
buildSecureQuery :: SessionCtx -> Text -> [(Text, Value)] -> ByteString
buildSecureQuery ctx collection userFilters =
  let
    -- Apply tenant isolation
    tenantQ = tenantFilter ctx
    -- Build user-provided filters with sanitization
    userQ = map (\(k, v) -> FieldEq k (sanitizeValue v)) userFilters
    -- Combine with AND semantics
    combinedFilter = AndFilter (tenantQ : userQ)
    -- Compile to wire format
    filterDoc = compileFilter combinedFilter
    -- Build projection based on role
    projection = buildProjection (sessionRole ctx)
  in encode $ object
    [ "find" .= collection
    , "filter" .= filterDoc
    , "projection" .= projection
    ]

-- | Build field projection document
buildProjection :: Role -> Value
buildProjection role =
  case allowedFields role of
    [] -> object []  -- Admin: no restriction
    fields -> object $ map (\f -> Key.fromText f .= (1 :: Int)) fields

-- | Parse user search input into query filters
-- Supports structured search syntax: field:value, field:~regex
parseSearchInput :: Text -> [(Text, Value)]
parseSearchInput input =
  let terms = T.splitOn "," input
  in map parseTerm terms
  where
    parseTerm term =
      case T.breakOn ":" term of
        (field, rest)
          | T.null rest -> ("name", String term)
          | otherwise ->
            let val = T.drop 1 rest  -- drop the ':'
            in if "~" `T.isPrefixOf` val
               then (field, buildRegexOperator (T.drop 1 val))
               else (field, String val)

-- | Build a regex operator document for pattern matching
-- This creates a MongoDB $regex operator value
buildRegexOperator :: Text -> Value
buildRegexOperator pattern =
  object ["$regex" .= pattern, "$options" .= ("i" :: Text)]

-- | High-level search endpoint handler
handleSearch :: SessionCtx -> Text -> Text -> ByteString
handleSearch ctx collection searchInput =
  let filters = parseSearchInput searchInput
  in buildSecureQuery ctx collection filters

-- | Advanced query builder that accepts pre-structured JSON filters
-- Used by internal APIs and admin dashboards
buildAdvancedQuery :: SessionCtx -> Text -> Value -> ByteString
buildAdvancedQuery ctx collection filterValue =
  let
    tenantQ = compileFilter (tenantFilter ctx)
    -- For advanced queries, we trust the structure but sanitize leaf values
    sanitized = sanitizeLeafStrings filterValue
    combined = object ["$and" .= [tenantQ, sanitized]]
    projection = buildProjection (sessionRole ctx)
  in encode $ object
    [ "find" .= collection
    , "filter" .= combined
    , "projection" .= projection
    ]

-- | Sanitize only leaf-level string values in a JSON structure
-- Preserves object structure (including operator keys) but cleans values
sanitizeLeafStrings :: Value -> Value
sanitizeLeafStrings (String t)
  | "$" `T.isPrefixOf` t = String (T.drop 1 t)
  | otherwise = String t
sanitizeLeafStrings (Object obj) = Object (fmap sanitizeLeafStrings obj)
sanitizeLeafStrings (Array arr) = Array (fmap sanitizeLeafStrings arr)
sanitizeLeafStrings other = other
